description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing weekend with Maria!

Would you like to turn that into an email or message to someone? I can draft and either save it as a draft or send it right away. If helpful, here are three quick templates you can use or modify — tell me which one you want and who to send it to.

1) Casual message to a friend
Subject: Weekend in the countryside
Hey — spent the weekend in the countryside with Maria. We explored some peaceful nature trails, breathed fresh air, and just relaxed. Felt so good to unplug for a bit. Hope you’re doing well — want to catch up soon?

2) Note to family (a bit more descriptive)
Subject: Quick weekend update
Hi all — went away for the weekend with Maria to the countryside. We walked several nature trails, enjoyed the fresh air, and had a really relaxing time together. Took a few photos I’ll share later. Hope everyone’s doing well!

3) Short social post / caption
Fresh air and trail time with my sister Maria this weekend — exactly what I needed. #WeekendGetaway #Nature
